versions.content: Name E2E_ P02Protect State Type Kind Structure Elements Counter Type uint8 Comment Counter to be used for protecting the Data. The initial value is 0. As the counter is incremented before sending, the first Data will have the counter value 1 Description State of the sender for a Data protected with E2E Profile 2. Available via E2E.h
